items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: the bus that Mrs. Collins had chartered was to take us from Jackson to Little Rock.

ctx.x: So -- yeah, so the only one that didn't get thrown in the clanker was Mike McKendrick. He was out somewhere, doing something and he didn't get a chance to get into that. And the whole thing was, the bus that Mrs. Collins had chartered was to take us from Jackson to Little Rock.

Well, they carried us from Jackson to Memphis, and then they wanted to change the bus. They wanted us to get into a different bus. Well, she said, "No, I want -- the bus that I want them to have --" so Louis could have this seat, to ra'r back in, to sleep. But they wanted to give us a little bus with the seats sitting straight up this way.
